form.mode: Road trip in our own car
form.idealTripDescription: Family with one child of 8. Quiet viewpoints, good local food on the way, a spice plantation, a boat ride and one lesser-known waterfall.

plan.title: Spice Trails & Lake Calm
plan.summary: A relaxed 3‑day family road trip from Madurai to Thekkady with scenic ghats, a Periyar lake boat ride, and an authentic spice‑garden walk. Planned with short daylight drives, vegetarian food stops, and quiet viewpoints that suit an 8‑year‑old and parents.
plan.weather: Pleasant winter in the high ranges: mornings/evenings 13–19°C, afternoons 22–27°C. Northeast‑monsoon tails can bring brief showers in December; expect mist at dawn and clear, bright days ideal for boating and viewpoints. Pack light woollens and a rain jacket for the child for early starts.
alerts: Peak crowds: Dec 19–21 falls in Kerala’s December high season and overlaps with Sabarimala Mandala pilgrimage (Nov 16–Dec 27, 2026) – roads around Kumily/Thekkady and nearby KK Road can be busier; book boating and hotel early.
Periyar boat safari and entry use timed slots and ID‑matched e‑tickets; report 30 minutes before departure and use the Anavachal parking–shuttle to the boat landing.
Idukki hills issue night‑travel advisories during heavy‑rain alerts; plan all ghat driving in daylight and re‑check the district advisory the day before.

accommodation.name: Abad Green Forest, Thekkady
accommodation.mapsQuery: Abad Green Forest, Opp RC Church, Thekkady Junction, Kerala
accommodation.reason: Central location walkable to Kumily market and Periyar gate, family‑friendly rooms, pool, and reliable vegetarian buffet options that suit mid‑range budgets in peak season.

roadTrip.recommendedRoute: Madurai → Theni → Cumbum → Kumily (Thekkady). Fastest and flattest till Cumbum, then a short, gentle ghat to Kumily with good daylight views and reliable veg food stops.
roadTrip.departAt: Day 1, 07:00 from Madurai – clears city traffic, puts you on the Kumily ghat by late morning in full daylight and in time for an easy check‑in and sunset viewpoint.

routes.name: Via Theni–Cumbum (NH 85/KK Road)
routes.via: Madurai – Usilampatti – Andipatti – Theni – Chinnamanur – Cumbum – Kumily
routes.road: Four/smooth two‑lane highways till Cumbum, then a short, well‑marked ghat climb to Kumily; occasional slowdowns in Theni/Cumbum towns.
routes.bestFor: Speed, reliable services, and the most vegetarian food choices en route

routes.name: Via Periyakulam–Theni (NH network + SH)
routes.via: Madurai – Vadipatti – Periyakulam – Theni – Cumbum – Kumily
routes.road: Mix of NH and state highways with more town traffic around Periyakulam; scenic Vaigai-side sections; same final ghat to Kumily.
routes.bestFor: Scenery and a break at Vaigai Dam Park

routes.name: Via Bypass to Theni (NH 44 connector → NH 85)
routes.via: Madurai Ring/BYP – Usilampatti – Andipatti – Theni – Cumbum – Kumily
routes.road: Bypass helps skip inner‑city; similar surfaces; watch town speed cameras.
routes.bestFor: Quickest city exit if starting near Madurai Bypass

tips: FASTag works on all tolls on this corridor; keep some cash for small parking/entry booths.
Petrol top‑up at Madurai/Theni to avoid higher hill prices; tyre pressure slightly lower for better grip on ghats.
Ghat etiquette: use engine braking, avoid night driving; expect mist pockets near Kumily at dawn/dusk.
Periyar programs are capacity‑controlled; carry the same photo ID used for booking; parking is at Anavachal with a mandatory shuttle to the boat landing.
Weekends in December get crowded; start activities early and reserve dining slots at your hotel if possible.

gettingThere.option: Own car via Theni – Cumbum – Kumily
gettingThere.costInr: 3,000–3,800 for the family (fuel + one‑way tolls, both ways ≈ ₹6,000–7,500 incl. local drives)
gettingThere.note: Most flexible for a child, easy luggage handling, and ideal for misty viewpoints at your own pace.

plan.recommendation: Drive your own car via Theni–Cumbum for the shortest, smoothest route with reliable vegetarian food stops and safer daylight ghats. Park at your hotel and use short local drives or hotel taxis within Thekkady.

days.title: Into the Spice Hills
days.narrative: Roll out from Madurai after breakfast, watch the plains turn to cardamom hills, and settle into a leafy resort. End the day above the valley with a pastel sunset and cool breeze.

activities.name: Drive Madurai → Thekkady with Theni coffee halt
activities.description: Daylight drive with a coffee/snack break; reach Kumily by late morning. Check in and rest.
activities.heroMoment: First whiff of spice‑laden, cool air as you crest into Kumily.

activities.name: Ottakathalamedu Viewpoint (sunset)
activities.mapsQuery: Ottakathalamedu View Point Road, Kumily, Kerala
activities.description: Short drive and 5–10 min stroll to the grassy bluff and watchtower. 60–75 min including photos.
activities.heroMoment: Golden light over Periyar Lake and the Tamil Nadu plains from the hilltop watchtower.

activities.name: Kumily Market Stroll
activities.description: Gentle walk past spice shops; window‑shop without committing—buy after your plantation tour tomorrow. 45–60 min.
activities.heroMoment: Cardamom and clove aromas as lanterns come on along the bazaar.

days.food: Breakfast in Madurai; simple lunch en route (Aarthy Veg, Cumbum) or at the resort; dinner at Nava Jyoti/Arya Bhavan for hot chapati, veg kurma, and appam–stew.
days.stay: Kumily–Thekkady Junction area (walkable to Periyar gate)

hiddenGems.name: Chellarkovil Watchtower Garden
hiddenGems.why: Quiet terraced garden and tower with a long view over the Cumbum valley; often skipped by tour buses.
hiddenGems.tip: Late afternoon for soft light; carry a light jacket for breeze; small entry fees at the tower.

liveAlerts.description: Saturday + December crowd near Kumily checkpost can slow the last 10 km.
liveAlerts.alternativeSuggestion: If you’re delayed, skip the market stroll and go straight to Ottakathalamedu for sunset.

liveAlerts.description: Evening mist or wind on the viewpoint.
liveAlerts.alternativeSuggestion: Do a relaxed spice‑market and early dinner; try the viewpoint at sunrise tomorrow.

days.title: Lake, Spices & a Secret Falls
days.narrative: Glide across Periyar’s calm waters scanning for elephants, learn how cardamom and pepper grow, then cruise a scenic ridge to a misty roadside waterfall.

activities.name: Periyar Lake Boat Safari
activities.mapsQuery: Boat Landing, Periyar Tiger Reserve, Thekkady
activities.description: Report 30 min early at Anavachal parking for the shuttle; 1.5‑hour guided boat ride.
activities.heroMoment: Still water reflecting forested slopes as cormorants skim the surface.

activities.name: Abraham’s Spice Garden tour
activities.mapsQuery: Abraham’s Spice Garden, Spring Valley, Kumily
activities.description: 45–75 min guided walk through an organic garden—pepper vines, cardamom, cinnamon; Q&A for kids.
activities.heroMoment: Crushing a leaf to smell fresh cinnamon and bay right on the plant.

activities.name: Valanjanganam (Ninnumullippara) Waterfalls
activities.description: Scenic 22–25 km drive from Thekkady (NH 183). Roadside cascade with misty spray; 40–50 min halt.
activities.heroMoment: Cool spray and tea‑scented breeze as clouds hug the ridge.

days.food: Breakfast early at the resort/near gate; lunch at Nava Jyoti or Arya Bhavan (pure veg); evening snack at Grandma’s Cafe (veg options) or resort dinner.

hiddenGems.name: Parunthumpara Viewpoint
hiddenGems.why: Open ridge with vast views a short drive beyond Kuttikkanam; quieter than popular town lookouts.
hiddenGems.tip: Pair with Valanjanganam; park at designated lot and keep the child within the fenced zones.

liveAlerts.description: Periyar boating slots sell out early in December weekends/holidays.
liveAlerts.alternativeSuggestion: If sold out, book the next slot and add Chellarkovil/Ottakathalamedu in the free window.

liveAlerts.description: Intermittent drizzle or low cloud on NH 183 near Kuttikkanam.
liveAlerts.alternativeSuggestion: Skip the Kuttikkanam run and linger at Chellarkovil + a plantation cafe instead.

days.title: Easy Ride Home
days.narrative: A hearty vegetarian breakfast, a last look at the hills, and a daylight return with a garden stroll by Vaigai Dam to keep the drive child‑friendly.

activities.name: Breakfast & checkout
activities.description: Appam–stew or mini‑tiffin; start by 09:00–09:15 to reach Theni plains by midday.
activities.heroMoment: Steam off hot appams as the morning chill lifts.

activities.name: Vaigai Dam Park leg‑stretch
activities.description: Short garden walk and reservoir view; child‑safe paths; 30–40 min.
activities.heroMoment: Family photo on the viewing bridge with the reservoir behind.

activities.name: Arrive Madurai
activities.description: City entry in daylight; lunch stop if you prefer inside the city.
activities.heroMoment: Rolling back into familiar streets with spice‑shop souvenirs in the boot.

days.food: Breakfast in Thekkady; lunch at Sri Sivaa (Theni) or on arrival in Madurai; keep fruit/snacks and water for the child.

hiddenGems.name: Periyakulam Riverside (quick pause)
hiddenGems.why: A small town detour with river views and mango groves; nice five‑minute breather if the child needs it.
hiddenGems.tip: Stop only at obvious parking bays; avoid riverbanks after rains.

liveAlerts.description: Weekday market traffic in Theni/Periyakulam around noon.
liveAlerts.alternativeSuggestion: Skirt town centres via signed bypasses; time a slightly later lunch at Andipatti.
